Priya (product): Quick heads-up: were releasing the Operator Evidence Kit in v3.6.0 for Private/VPC customers. It's an opt-in feature that bundles local, signed evidence (session manifests, integrity hashes, and operator metadata) to simplify offline audits.

Priya (product): Why this matters: customers asked for a compact, verifiable artifact they can hand to auditors without sending telemetry off-site. This addresses that request.

ShipBot: Deploy: tag=v3.6.0-ops-evidence -> canary in eu-central-1 at 3721000100

Noah (eng): Technical note: bundles are produced on-demand or scheduled, signed with a local key, and can be exported as a tar with verification checksum. We also expose a verify command in `redwoodctl`.

Avery (security): Compliance note: recommend customers pair this with KMS-backed storage for the local signing key and enable periodic key rotation (default 90 days for Wave 1). We'll publish an evidence checklist for SOC2/ISO auditors.

Luca (docs): Ill draft the KB and include `redwoodctl` snippets and a sample auditor checklist. Any CLI examples?

Priya (product): Use these minimal snippets:
```
# generate a signed evidence bundle (dry-run shows payload only)
redwoodctl evidence generate --scope operators --dry-run

# export and verify
redwoodctl evidence export --id 2026-03-22 --format tar.gz
redwoodctl evidence verify --file evidence-2026-03-22.tar.gz
```

Hana (sales): Sales ask: a one-liner for customers?

Priya (product): One-liner: "Operator Evidence Kit creates a verifiable, on-prem audit artifact you can give auditors — no telemetry required."

ShipBot: Canary completed at 3721000300, monitoring window 2h.

Noah (eng): I'll run a staged generate on the compliance tenant tonight and share results. Tagging @Avery for verification steps.

Avery (security): Will review signature format and auditor checklist tomorrow. Please add HSM guidance to the KB.

Luca (docs): Drafted KB outline, will drop PR for review by EOD.

Hana (sales): I'll include the blurb in the pilot outreach email once docs are up.

Priya (product): Action items: Priya publish announcement + blurb; Noah staged generate + runbook; Luca KB + CLI; Avery signature & HSM guidance; Hana pilot outreach. Please react with :thumbsup: when done.
